_meta.status: PROPOSED contract — authored by the coding agent, awaits human review. Not implemented in src/ and not human-approved.
_meta.purpose: Structured judgement the bear node asks the quick-tier model for once per complete round satisfying 2 <= round < cap. The node maps this to exactly one of PROGRESS / NO_PROGRESS / UNKNOWN and persists it before the Research Manager runs.
_meta.delimiter: The judge is invoked at most max(0, cap-2) times per run; zero for cap 1 and 2. The router and manager never re-judge.

new_evidence.description: The bull turn introduces a fact/observation not already present in the prior debate history, judged by meaning (numbers, qualitative claims, or held/refuted points alike).

first_reply.description: The bull turn gives a first substantive response to a specific opposing argument that had no prior substantive response in this history.

confidence.description: The judge's confidence in the two booleans for this side.

new_evidence.description: The bear turn introduces a fact/observation not already present in the prior history plus the current bull turn.

first_reply.description: The bear turn gives a first substantive response to a bull point that had no prior substantive response, including a first reply within the same pair.

outcome.description: The judge may also return UNKNOWN directly when it cannot decide.

deterministic_mapping.rule: outcome_of(judgement) is computed by the node, not taken on trust if inconsistent.
steps: If the structured call fails, returns None, or the payload is not an object with the required keys -> UNKNOWN.
If any confidence is 'low' for a side whose flags are all false (i.e. we would otherwise stop on that side's weakness) -> UNKNOWN (do not stop on a weak negative).
If the payload's own outcome field contradicts the booleans (PROGRESS with all flags false, or NO_PROGRESS with any flag true) -> UNKNOWN (inconsistent).
PROGRESS if any of bull.new_evidence, bull.first_reply, bear.new_evidence, bear.first_reply is true.
NO_PROGRESS only if all four flags are false AND both sides' confidence is at least 'medium' AND the outcome field agrees.

failure_handling.unknown: Continue the debate (fail open). The round cap and speaker order are unchanged; the persisted outcome is UNKNOWN with an empty early-stop reason.
failure_handling.no_freetext_retry: A failed structured judgement becomes UNKNOWN once. The judge is never retried as free text. Provider/SDK-level transport retries (existing client behaviour) are not judgement attempts and are not counted as such.
